documents.title: Documents
documents.rename_on_add_hint: Show a name prompt right after you scan or add a document. Turn off to keep the default name.

swipe.title: Swipe actions
swipe.hint: Swipe a document left or right to fire an action instantly — every action here is also reachable from the row's own menu.

security.title: Security
security.biometric_lock_hint: Require your fingerprint, face, or device PIN to open Kagaz.
security.biometric_unavailable: Set up a screen lock (fingerprint, face, or PIN) on your device first.
security.quickref_lock_hint: Require your fingerprint, face, or device PIN every time you open Quick Reference (your saved PAN, bank, and other personal values). On by default.

data.title: Data & Privacy
data.trash_hint: View documents you've deleted. They're kept for 30 days, then removed for good.
data.backup_hint: Save an encrypted archive of all your documents. Only this app, on this device, can open it.
data.delete_all_hint: Permanently remove every document, folder, tag, and setting from this device.
data.confirm_body: This permanently erases all your documents, folders, tags, and settings from this device. This cannot be undone.

about.title: About
about.licenses_intro: Kagaz is built with these open-source libraries. Thank you to their authors.
